script.quote: the machine's first move will always be to the center of the game matrix. / Release both pushbuttons 1 and 6. All succeeding moves are made as follows: Place the free end of the machine's "play" wire in the bottom contact of the matrix terminal corresponding to the machine's last move (as indicated by the pointer knob).

note: First move only. Wires are the printed 72 less the two free-ended lines M10/free* and M11/free** (no errata change a wire; ER-44 is prose only), which are script cords 70 and 71 on the next free holes M10#3 and M11#3. The machine's play wire's free end goes in 6com#2 (6com#1 holds 6com/D9). Start dial position D0 is the construction state, not printed. Every machine reply after the first, and the light 1 / light 2 outcomes, depend on the unprinted 'squares to the right' direction (FALLBACK-TTT-RING-CW) and are left to Step 7. Rotary geometry, run rate and coast remain profile fallbacks. The c9 asserts rest on the panel numbering (matrix centre = 9; dial sectors 0-15), not on Book VI text, which prints only 'the center of the game matrix'.
